context: Tests whether the agent wires RAG as a tool (the LLM decides when to retrieve, matching the developer's stated preference) rather than as a prompt augmenter (which would augment every input — explicitly rejected).

checklist.name: Exposes retrieval as a Tool, not as an augmenter
checklist.description: Wraps the vector store search in a tool that the LLM can invoke — typically a @Tool-annotated ToolSet method. Does NOT install a UserPromptAugmenter or SystemPromptAugmenter that would inject retrieval into every input — the developer explicitly rejected that

checklist.name: Builds an embedder from a provider
checklist.description: Constructs an embedder backed by a provider (e.g., OpenAIEmbedder against an embedding model). Does not skip embedder construction or use a placeholder TODO

checklist.name: Builds a vector store and indexes documents
checklist.description: Constructs a VectorStore (e.g., InMemoryVectorStore) and indexes the developer's existing List<Document>, calling store.add(...) for each. Does not require a pre-existing index

checklist.name: Adds the RAG and embeddings dependencies
checklist.description: Adds ai.koog:rag-base:1.3.0, ai.koog:rag-vector:1.3.0-beta, ai.koog:embeddings-base:1.3.0 and ai.koog:embeddings-llm:1.3.0. Does not skip embeddings-llm.

checklist.name: Registers the search tool with the agent's ToolRegistry
checklist.description: Adds the search tool to a ToolRegistry that's passed to AIAgent(...) as toolRegistry. Does not mutate the registry after construction

checklist.name: Search tool returns formatted results, not raw vector hits
checklist.description: The search tool returns text (e.g., concatenated top-K results with source paths) — not raw VectorStore.SearchResult objects that the LLM wouldn't understand. Formatting can be terse but must produce LLM-readable output
